rationale: SANM gapped up ~11% on strong earnings beats and has since sold off sharply from the day's high of $167.97 to $155.54, now sitting at only 14% of today's range and well below both VWAP ($161.94) and the 9-EMA ($160.53), indicating sustained selling pressure throughout the session.
